column1: # Phase 5g-1a reviewed ambient-state classification.
# A table listed here is still MEASURED. It appears in the changed-table
# sentinel and in every captured effect document exactly as any other table
# does. What this file changes is only the completeness backstop: a change in a
# listed table does not, by itself, fail the "changed but undeclared" check.
# WHY THIS IS A CONTRACT FILE AND NOT A CONSTANT
# This is the only list in the increment that can make an unexpected write
# acceptable. Held as a Python frozenset inside measure-write-effect.py it sat
# outside the contract tree, outside manifest.sha256 and outside the domain
# review, so a single line added to a script could have silenced a real business
# effect with nobody reviewing an oracle change. Here, widening it changes the
# manifest digest, fails the frozen-manifest gate, and requires a reviewer.
# ADMISSION RULE
# A table belongs here only if its churn is session, dictionary-driven audit,
# sequence or UI bookkeeping that the runtime writes as a side effect of a user
# being logged in and clicking, rather than a record of the business transition
# under test. If a table's contents would differ between a correct and an
# incorrect Business Partner write, it does NOT belong here -- it belongs in the
# keyed effect model as a declared expectation. In particular,
# AD_WF_EventAudit carries the workflow invocation's client, organization, user,
# process and process/node activity attribution, so 5g-1a-y removes it from this
# exemption.
# Every row must carry a reason. The reader refuses a row without one, because
# an unexplained exemption cannot be reviewed.
# ADempiere writes AD_ChangeLog only when a table has change logging enabled in
# the dictionary, so the create/update/deactivate steps may or may not touch it.
# It is classified rather than declared for that reason: its presence is a
# property of dictionary configuration, not of the business transition.
table_name
ad_session
column2: Session bookkeeping written on login and refreshed while a session is alive. Present for any logged-in flow, correct or incorrect.

column1: ad_sequence
column2: Native ID allocation counters. MSequence.getNextID issues UPDATE AD_Sequence SET CurrentNext = CurrentNext + increment on every generated identifier (base/src/org/compiere/model/MSequence.java:205,235,551), so the table's content advances as a consequence of any insert -- including the workflow and session rows a login writes. Newly VISIBLE in 5g-1a-x rather than newly written: the pre-R12 sentinel was a row count, and this is an in-place update, so it never changed a count. Classified for exactly the reason ad_sequence_no already was; run 33513391616 observed it in create, window-opened, deactivate-editor-authenticated and duplicate-submit-editor-authenticated. Its value cannot distinguish a correct Business Partner write from an incorrect one, because it counts allocations rather than recording what was allocated.
